name: add_home_widget
description: Add or remove a live widget on the Jarvis home screen dashboard. Widget types: 'tv' = TV remote, 'printer' = 3D printer status, 'weather-home' = current weather, 'ha-device' = Home Assistant device card (multiple devices), 'ha-toggle' = single glowing power button for ONE specific device. IMPORTANT — when adding an 'ha-toggle': call home_assistant_command with command='list_devices' FIRST to get exact entity IDs, then pass entity_ids=[exact entity_id] and label=short human name (e.g. 'Light 2').

parameters.description: Use 'add' to show a widget on the home screen. Use 'remove' to close/hide it.

Which widget. 'tv' = TV remote. 'printer' = 3D printer status. 'weather-home' = weather. 'ha-device' = HA device card (multiple devices). 'ha-toggle' = single glowing power button for one specific device (use after calling list_devices to get the entity_id).
Optional custom title for the widget header, e.g. 'Living Room TV'.
For widget_type='printer': the printer name, e.g. 'X1 Carbon'. Omit for all printers.
For widget_type='ha-device': HA domain to filter, e.g. 'light', 'switch', 'climate'.
For widget_type='ha-toggle' or 'ha-device': comma-separated exact HA entity IDs, e.g. 'switch.light_2' or 'switch.light_1,switch.light_2'. Get these from list_devices first.
For widget_type='ha-device': fuzzy name filter, e.g. 'bedroom'. For ha-toggle prefer entity_ids instead.
For widget_type='ha-toggle': short display name shown under the power button, e.g. 'Light 2'. Always set this.
